decisions.reason: It stayed on its own webpage through 2024, fits the firm’s core data-and-analytics platform well, and its likely low carrying cost leaves useful upside under still-uncertain customer adoption.

Its downgrade from a dedicated page to only a website mention suggests weaker realized value or partial replacement, and with a broad product portfolio the firm is likely to reallocate resources from this narrower option.

Although no longer promoted as a standalone page, it is closely tied to the firm’s maintained regional market data and platform integration capabilities, so it still has enough option value to justify staying available.
